text:
alisha: quick thought experiment: instead of emitting per-span heartbeats, what if edge maintained a small bloom filter + count-min sketch and exported periodic compact summaries for billing? would cut cardinality and bandwidth.

trent: high-level: bloom to detect dups, cms for counts. interesting. what's your error tolerance?

alisha: prototype targets ~1% overcount for common services, with a 1MB CMS per gateway instance updated every minute. bloom used only to suppress exact duplicates in the fast path. summary envelope: {gateway_id, tenant, window_start, cms_bytes_base64, bloom_sha256}.

maya: 1% sounds doable for SaaS defaults. two concerns: 1) CMS gives only overestimates. 2) Summaries complicate debugging + per-trace fidelity.

rob: agree. Also operationally: if gateway crashes we lose the in-memory sketches for that minute unless we persist. We could rotate logs to local SSD every 10s and have central collector reassemble. But that adds IO.

alisha: implementation choices: write-ahead append every 10s (compact) vs. ephemeral with retransmit on graceful shutdown. I'm leaning write-ahead for resilience. cost overhead measured in prototype: ~3-4MB/s per 10k rps in worst-case due to rotation.

trent: how do we map CMS counters to tokens? we need token_estimate per span. If token_estimate is approximate, compounding error may be worse.

maya: we can bucket token sizes into small bins (e.g., 0-16,17-64,65-256,>256) and keep separate CMS per bin. reduces skew from heavy tails.

alisha: good idea. bucketed-CMS + bloom for exact duplication. That yields smaller per-window error for token volume. summary envelope grows but still << per-span heartbeat.

billing-bot: note: downstream billing expects deterministic per-span records for audit; any probabilistic approach means we must label invoices as "approximate" unless a customer opts in to exact mode.

rob: enterprise opt-out is essential. For those customers, edge should either not dedupe or write full spans upstream. We should add an "exact_billing" tenant flag.

trent: UI implications: billing console must display an estimated error bound and a sample-based confidence interval. Also an "export raw" button to retrieve raw central events when exact mode was on.

maya: question about cardinality: CMS reduces cardinality, but we still need tenant x route dims on the summary topic. Are we ok with that cardinality?

alisha: summary uses a fixed routing key = tenant|route. We don't include per-fingerprint identifiers. The bloom is only used locally to suppress duplicates but not sent. Only the bloom SHA is included to trace debug state. So central cardinality limited to tenant-route windows.

trent: how to handle replays/backfills? If we discover billing mismatch, we need a way to force gateways to stream raw spans for a historical window. Can we support a central request that triggers a gateway re-send from local SSD logs for a given minute range?

rob: yes if we persist rotations. We'll need playbook: ensure we retain N minutes of local rotation depending on SLA and provide a secure retrieval endpoint. SRE involvement required.

maya: tests: 1) simulation harness: take 72h of existing trace traffic, run through bloom+bucketed-CMS and compare to raw counts. 2) adversarial test: many unique small spans to see CMS collisions.

alisha: perf: gateway CPU overhead ~2% on prototype; memory ~1MB per shard for bloom + 1MB per bucket CMS; disk writeback minimal if batched. Need validation at 100k rps.

trent: rollout strategy: stage 0 = mark-only (no dedupe, send summaries) for a subset of tenants 1% traffic; stage 1 = soft-dedupe with summaries and allow central reconciliation; stage 2 = default soft-dedupe for public tenants. Enterprise tenants set exact_billing=true.

billing-bot: action required for billing team: define invoice language and a per-tenant toggle in billing API. Also determine acceptable SLA for estimated invoices.

rob: SRE items: implement local rotation for sketches, retrieval API, and alerting when disk usage or write failures happen. Add circuit-breaker to disable dedupe if resource pressure > threshold.

maya: UX: traces should show a short banner when probe summaries were used for billing. For missing spans, we can offer "fetch raw" if raw spans were persisted.

alisha: I'll draft an RFC with: architecture diagram, summary envelope schema, error bounds math, simulation results, rollout plan, and required console/billing changes.

trent: owners: alisha (RFC + prototype), rob (rotation + retrieval), maya (simulations + UX), trent (central reconciliation + console), billing-bot (billing policy). Put ticket INF-7410 in tracker.

sre-bot: Reminder: created infra ticket INF-7410 to coordinate gateway rotation and retrieval endpoints.

alisha: thanks all. I'll post the RFC link in #eng-platform when ready.
